title: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Aftermath

html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Travel throughout Lower Shadow's Embrace and rough up the locals until they give up their counterfeit King's Coins. Return to Sir Ving N'Seacressy once you have a handful.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Post-Aftermath

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Travel throughout Lower Shadow's Embrace and rough up the locals until they give up their counterfeit King's Coins. Return to Sir Ving N'Seacressy once you have a handful.

Offer:

K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S. is getting reports of additional counterfeit King's Coins being distributed throughout the Lower Shadow's Embrace...not that I am affiliated with K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S., mind you.

Between you and I, it boggles me that people think these counterfeits are real. I mean, come on...they're not made of metal, they're made of cardboard!

Undoubtably, it would be of great service to the kingdom if someone would take those counterfeits out of circulation!

Turn-in:

Those counterfeiters just won't give up. I suspect those K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S. chaps will need an ongoing campaign against the Haxhaxors and their evil ways.

Objectives:

  • Counterfeit King's Coin ×6

Client level range: 51–100
